printf 'service_active='; systemctl is-active nginx
printf 'service_enabled='; systemctl is-enabled nginx
printf 'selinux='; sudo semanage port -l | grep '^http_port_t' | grep -w 6700
printf 'firewall_runtime='; sudo firewall-cmd --query-port=6700/tcp
printf 'firewall_permanent='; sudo firewall-cmd --permanent --query-port=6700/tcp
curl --noproxy '*' -sS -D /tmp/nginx-final-headers -o /tmp/nginx-final-body -w 'http_code=%{http_code}\nremote_ip=%{remote_ip}\nremote_port=%{remote_port}\n' "http://$NODE_IP:6700/"
sed -n '1p' /tmp/nginx-final-headers
printf 'body_title='; grep -m1 '<title>' /tmp/nginx-final-body
